record.oneLiner: SEO data API (Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Rank Tracker and more) that uses API keys and consumes monthly API units.
record.verdictReason: API v3 access requires a Lite or higher paid subscription and consumes API units, so it cannot be used on a free account. Keys are self-serve once a paid plan is held, and Ahrefs publishes a hosted MCP server on paid plans.

evidence.quote: Create and manage your API keys
Using API v3 from any of the above methods is possible for Lite and higher subscription plans.
The remote MCP server is available on paid plans starting from Lite.
